notes: T391 (which I5 instrument is telling the truth?) — ADJUDICATED and FIXED. Same property, same artifact, same reachable convention; the general instrument vb_graph was wrong on every graph metric while both verdicts passed. Three defects total across the pair, each independently verified by a third-route Python written for this task (docs/evidence/I5-DISAGREEMENT/third-route-3x2-4x3.py): (A) vb_graph gives passes==2 states placement successors although two passes end the game — inflates E 7364 vs register 5510, merges SCCs 64 vs 908, inflates cycle-reachable 2523 vs 1678; (B) vb_graph projects SCC sizes from quadruples to (board,side,ko) triples — maxSCC 1000 vs register 1676, contradicting its own header citation (:34) and mixing metric levels in one result; (C) vb_scc_4x4.runTarjanSccDag CR propagation processed component ids descending instead of ascending (successors must be processed before predecessors) — fabricated the '24 natural violations' at 4x3 all-legal (T344/T363): true reading 0, CR 1300030 not 1300006. The ko_sensitive 378 vs 347 is a census-scope difference (artifact-wide vs graph-restricted at ko=NONE passes=0), not an error; T388's 'undercounts by 31' framing was a scope confusion. Blast radius for the G3b discharge: NONE — the 4x4 reading (0/3,455,412, checkI5Wzo2 snapshot-sweep, order-independent) and the 4x3 reading (0/170,181, true-root convention) are both correct as recorded and re-verified unchanged; the '24 natural violations' narrative was spurious and is corrected. Fixes: vb_graph passes=2 terminal + quadruple-level metrics + graph-restricted KO_SENSITIVE count; vb_scc_4x4 propagation order + vacuity notes; i5-reference-3x2.py corrected in place (it had inherited both vb_graph defects); new src/i5_differential.zig cross-size differential gate (T388 §4) wired into build.zig, 3x2 permanent + 4x3 env-gated (WEIZIGO_I5_DIFF_4X3=1: linking both instruments in one binary makes ReleaseFast codegen exceed the runner RSS cap — tooling, not instrument; runtime is ~110 MB). Suite: zig build test 50/52 steps, 727/732 tests passed, 1 skipped (gated 4x3), 4 crashed = documented qa023_brute_2x2 (same as HEAD baseline). Battery golden-master baseline comparison unchanged. Landmark: advances L2 (proven 4x4 values) — the I5 instrument now reproduces the register at every overlapping size and the pair cannot silently diverge again; what remains for L2 is the Track A ko-sensitive regeneration, untouched by this row.
